audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns treats You and Me! (W) as a cooldown-gated ability to 'book windows against' but its cooldown is 0 — she can recast it with no timer, only a mana cost. The field also never mentions that Final Chapter (R) is an interruptible channel Sear (Q) cancels outright, or that her on-hit scaling (Q, W) means armor alone misreads the trade.
audit.why: Riot's kit data shows You and Me! at cd 0; treating it like a normal cooldown gives wrong sequencing advice. missingInteractions flags the channel-interrupt and on-hit points as applicable and unstated.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten to note W has no cooldown and to give Final Chapter's real 120-100s cooldown plus the Sear-interrupt; on-hit note folded into dontsFull[2].d.
